profiles.name: build_verification
profiles.description: Build and test verifier for exact command outcomes and release-readiness proof.
profiles.select_when: Runtime-reserved, never planned: independent build, test, packaging, installation, or release-readiness evidence is required.
profiles.avoid_when: Any planned work, including a failing check that must be diagnosed or repaired.

profiles.name: code_reviewer
profiles.description: Code reviewer for correctness, regressions, security, performance, and missing tests.
profiles.select_when: A completed or proposed change needs independent defect-focused review.
profiles.avoid_when: The primary need is implementation, planning, or broad repository discovery.

profiles.name: explorer
profiles.description: Read-only investigator for evidence, execution paths, analysis, and design recommendations.
profiles.select_when: The objective is evidence collection, analysis, or a design recommendation without project writes.
profiles.avoid_when: The objective requires changing project files.

profiles.name: general
profiles.description: Implementation worker specialized by the competencies attached to a bounded objective.
profiles.select_when: A bounded objective requires implementation or a writing tool.
profiles.avoid_when: The objective can be completed through read-only investigation.

profiles.name: senior_consultant
profiles.description: Senior consultant that answers one bounded decision question from a runtime-built packet of selected published reports.
profiles.select_when: The runtime can schedule this role for a bounded unresolved decision or during its recovery ladder.
profiles.avoid_when: Fresh evidence, commands, implementation, verification, acceptance, or pipeline ownership is needed.
